email_body:
Dear GAMIAN-Europe team,

I am writing to apply for the Communication Assistant internship. Your work bringing patient voices into European mental health policy resonates with me, and I would like to contribute my digital communication skills to your awareness-raising and EU-funded projects.

In my current roles as a freelance digital marketer and junior digital marketer at Episto, I manage WordPress websites, create newsletters and social media content, and use Canva for design. I have built and optimized sites for clients in healthcare and beyond, including a pharmacists' association site with around 600 member profiles. I am comfortable with MailChimp-style newsletter tools, paid social campaigns on Meta and LinkedIn, and using analytics to improve outreach. I am fluent in English and eager to learn more about Horizon Europe project communication.

I am based in Belgium, entitled to work in the EU, and available to work in Brussels for the six-month duration. I would welcome the chance to discuss how I can support GAMIAN-Europe's communication goals.

Kind regards,
Baver Ok
+32 470 42 48 36
baverok@gmail.com

cover_letter:
Dear GAMIAN-Europe team,

I am writing to express my interest in the Communication Assistant internship. GAMIAN-Europe's mission to improve the lives of people affected by mental health conditions through patient-centred advocacy and research is one I find deeply meaningful. I would be proud to contribute my digital communication skills to your awareness-raising activities and EU-funded projects.

In my current freelance work and my role as a Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I manage WordPress websites, create and publish content, and use Canva for design. I have built and optimized sites for clients in healthcare and other sectors, including a pharmacists' association site with around 600 member profile pages. My experience includes newsletter creation, social media posting, and running paid campaigns on Meta and LinkedIn. I regularly use analytics tools such as Google Analytics and Search Console to track and improve outreach. While I have not yet worked directly on Horizon Europe projects, I am eager to apply my skills to support the communication of EU-funded research and learn from your team.

I am based in Belgium, entitled to work in the EU, and available to be in Brussels for the six-month internship. I am fluent in English and have a strong interest in mental health advocacy. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how I can help strengthen GAMIAN-Europe's digital presence and support your campaigns.

Thank you for considering my application.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
cv_highlights:
• Proficient in WordPress, Elementor, and Canva for website management and design, directly applicable to GAMIAN-Europe's website and social media tasks.
• Experience creating and managing content for newsletters and social media, including paid campaigns on Meta and LinkedIn.
• Built and optimized websites for healthcare-related clients, including a pharmacists' association site with ~600 member profiles.
• Fluent in English and based in Belgium, entitled to work in the EU and available for a Brussels-based internship.
• Strong interest in mental health advocacy and eager to support communication of EU-funded research projects.
